questions.promptEn:
[11-12] 다음 글을 읽고 물음에 답하시오.

Eckels walked ⓐ______ the office of Time Travel. The big sign on the wall said, "NAME ANY YEAR ⓑ______ THE PAST. WE TAKE YOU THERE." There was a TV on the wall, and Mr. Keith, the new president, was ⓒ______ the news.

"How can we help you?" said Mr. Parker, the (A)[finder / founder] of Time Travel.

"I've always wanted to see a dinosaur. Is it possible?" asked Eckels.

"Sure," said Mr. Parker. "We can take you back ⓓ______ the jungle of 60 million years ago."

"Great," said Eckels. "Can you take me there now?"

"You're (B)[lucky / unlucky]. There's a time machine that leaves ⓔ______ 10 minutes," said Mr. Parker.

"This is Travis, your travel guide," he continued. "To stay safe, you (C)[must / don't have to] follow his instructions."

questions.promptEn:
[11-12] 다음 글을 읽고, 물음에 답하시오.

Eckels walked into the office of Time Travel. The big sign on the wall said, "NAME ANY YEAR IN THE PAST. WE TAKE YOU THERE." There was a TV on the wall, and Mr. Keith, the new president, was on the news.

"How can we help you?" said Mr. Parker, the (A)[finder / founder] of Time Travel.

"I've always wanted to see a dinosaur. Is it possible?" asked Eckels.

"Sure," said Mr. Parker. "We can take you back to the jungle of 60 million years ago."

"Great," said Eckels. "Can you take me there now?"

"You're (B)[lucky / unlucky]. There's a time machine that leaves in 10 minutes," said Mr. Parker.

"This is Travis, your travel guide," he continued. "To stay safe, you (C)[must / don't have to] follow his instructions."

"We've just arrived in the jungle of 60 million years ago," Travis explained. "Do you see the path over there? (A) You must not leave it at any time. Do not touch ⓒ[anything / nothing]. You might kill something by accident. (B) 변화가 미래에 상상할 수 없는 일을 일으킬 수 있습니다."

questions.explainKo: Eckels는 현재의 변화들이 자신이 과거에서 바꾸어 놓은 작은 변화(죽은 나비 한 마리)에서 비롯되었음을 알게 되었으므로 빈칸에는 ‘과거의 작은 변화’가 가장 적절하다. 현재로 돌아온 후에 Eckels는 이상한 것을 알아차렸다. 벽의 간판은 변했고, TV에 나오는 대통령도 달라졌다. 그는 마침내 과거의 작은 변화가 이러한 차이들을 만들어냈음을 깨닫게 되었다. ① 현재의 실수 ② 여행 규칙 준수 ④ 여행객의 주의 깊은 행동 ⑤ 타임머신의 오류.
questions.promptEn:
[24-25] 다음 글을 읽고, 물음에 답하시오.

The machine stopped. They all returned to the present safely.

"Is everything okay here?" asked Travis.

"Fine. Welcome home!" said Mr. Parker.

Eckels looked for the room carefully. Everything looked the same, except the big sign on the wall. The sign now said, "NAIM ANY YEER EN THE PAST. WEE TAEK YU THAIR."

Eckels was confused.

Then, he saw the TV. The new president was on the news, but it was not Mr. Keith. "What's going on?" He got more confused.

He sat down and looked closely at the mud on his shoes.

"No, it can't be," said Eckels. "It's all because of this little thing?" He was shocked. In the mud on his right shoe, he found a small dead butterfly.

윗글의 내용을 다음과 같이 요약할 때, 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

After he returned to the present, Eckels noticed something strange. The sign on the wall was changed, and the president on TV was different. He finally realized that ______ caused these differences.
choices: a small change in the past
the errors in the time machine
